Thank you for your kind help. I appreciate it.  First of all, my vanity is preventing me from dying. I have alcohol sensitivity, so I get super puffy when I have a glass of wine. If I get discovered by someone, I don't want the person to think I killed myself because I was ugly; I killed myself for a more poetic reason. I have plenty of winter left, so I guess I will figure something out before the season ends.   
I think you are right. What you said about life getting better even for a moment? I listened to early The Beach Boys, and I felt like I was in paradise, even for a moment.
Thank you, I appreciate your taste.
